title: Digital Legal Aid & Justice Innovation Grand Challenge
theme: Access to Justice, Legal Operations, Court Modernization, and Law + Computer Science Innovation

core_crisis_statistics.total_pending_cases: 4.639+ Million Cases (buckling lower courts and High Court)
core_crisis_statistics.under_trial_prisoners_rate: 70%+ of total incarcerated population are awaiting trial without conviction
core_crisis_statistics.legal_aid_awareness_gap: 97% of eligible citizens are unaware that free state legal aid exists (UNDP Bangladesh)
core_crisis_statistics.full_time_legal_aid_officers: Only 27 full-time officers serving 64 districts (approx. 1 per 6.3 million citizens)
core_crisis_statistics.average_civil_case_delay: 8 to 15 years to reach final appellate decree
core_crisis_statistics.rural_dialect_barrier: Over 40% of rural population speak regional dialects (Sylheti, Chittagonian, Rangpuri) unsupported by standard NLP

key_statutes_and_frameworks.name: Legal Aid Services Act 2000
key_statutes_and_frameworks.scope: Statutory foundation establishing NLASO, district legal aid committees, and citizen rights to free counsel.

key_statutes_and_frameworks.name: Village Courts Act 2006 (Amended 2013)
key_statutes_and_frameworks.scope: Grassroots Union Parishad adjudication of small civil disputes (up to BDT 75,000) and minor offenses.

key_statutes_and_frameworks.name: Code of Civil Procedure (CPC) Section 89A-89E
key_statutes_and_frameworks.scope: Mandatory judicial mediation and alternative dispute resolution mechanisms.

key_statutes_and_frameworks.name: Information and Communication Technology (ICT) Act 2006 & Cyber Security Act
key_statutes_and_frameworks.scope: Digital evidence admissibility, electronic signatures, and cybercrime jurisdiction.

key_statutes_and_frameworks.name: UNDP SDG 16: Peace, Justice and Strong Institutions
key_statutes_and_frameworks.scope: Target 16.3: Promote the rule of law at the national and international levels and ensure equal access to justice for all.
